name: query-style-diagnostic-v2
labelStatus: Assistant-reviewed diagnostic labels, revised after inspecting the previous lexical run and before this three-mode run. Two related public TypeScript repositories; not independent human labels or a held-out benchmark. Original labels are scored separately.

queries.query: atomic
queries.rationale: Locate the temporary exclusive write, rename, and unconditional cleanup.

queries.query: Where do we save a local record so another process cannot see half of the new contents, and remove leftover temporary data even on failure?
queries.rationale: Locate the temporary exclusive write, rename, and unconditional cleanup.

queries.query: How does atomic prevent partially written local records and clean up after failure?
queries.rationale: Locate the temporary exclusive write, rename, and unconditional cleanup.

queries.query: Where do we reject damaged text bytes instead of silently replacing them with replacement characters?
queries.rationale: Locate the decode/encode round-trip equality check and undefined result.

queries.query: How does utf8 detect decoding that would silently change the original bytes?
queries.rationale: Locate the decode/encode round-trip equality check and undefined result.

queries.query: utf8
queries.rationale: Locate the decode/encode round-trip equality check and undefined result.

queries.query: How does validateSettings restrict insecure connections and reject extra URL components?
queries.rationale: Locate the loopback exception and URL component validation; project/env checks are outside this task.

queries.query: validateSettings
queries.rationale: Locate the loopback exception and URL component validation; project/env checks are outside this task.

queries.query: Why can I connect without encryption on my own machine but not to a remote server, and why are credentials or extra URL components rejected?
queries.rationale: Locate the loopback exception and URL component validation; project/env checks are outside this task.

queries.query: canonical
queries.rationale: Locate key sorting, undefined omission and recursive value serialization.

queries.query: Where is an object turned into deterministic text so changing property insertion order does not change it, while missing values are left out?
queries.rationale: Locate key sorting, undefined omission and recursive value serialization.

queries.query: How does canonical produce deterministic object text and omit undefined properties?
queries.rationale: Locate key sorting, undefined omission and recursive value serialization.

queries.query: Where do we split an upload when either the number of records or encoded request size gets too large, including punctuation and wrapper overhead?
queries.rationale: Locate both limits, oversize-single-row rejection and serialized overhead accounting.

queries.query: How does planBatches enforce record and byte limits including request overhead?
queries.rationale: Locate both limits, oversize-single-row rejection and serialized overhead accounting.

queries.query: planBatches
queries.rationale: Locate both limits, oversize-single-row rejection and serialized overhead accounting.

queries.query: How does definitelyRejected distinguish definite rejection from timeouts and response validation failures?
queries.rationale: Both isInputError response exclusion and HTTP classification are required.

queries.query: definitelyRejected
queries.rationale: Both isInputError response exclusion and HTTP classification are required.

queries.query: Where do we distinguish an operation that certainly did not succeed from one that might have reached the server, including timeouts and malformed replies?
queries.rationale: Both isInputError response exclusion and HTTP classification are required.

queries.query: sanitize
queries.rationale: Locate reserved names, preservation of unchanged keys, suffix generation and recursive output.

queries.query: Where do we prevent two user-defined fields from overwriting one another after sensitive text is hidden from their names?
queries.rationale: Locate reserved names, preservation of unchanged keys, suffix generation and recursive output.

queries.query: How does sanitize avoid losing fields when redacted key names collide?
queries.rationale: Locate reserved names, preservation of unchanged keys, suffix generation and recursive output.

queries.query: Where does uploading stop after the first unsuccessful group while keeping counts of completed, uncertain, and untouched records and avoiding automatic resubmission?
queries.rationale: Locate retry disabling, failure classification, acknowledged/unknown/not-attempted counters and stop condition.

queries.query: How does importDocuments stop after a failed batch while preserving progress and disabling retries?
queries.rationale: Locate retry disabling, failure classification, acknowledged/unknown/not-attempted counters and stop condition.

queries.query: importDocuments
queries.rationale: Locate retry disabling, failure classification, acknowledged/unknown/not-attempted counters and stop condition.
